name: ACE Web — Team Chat Harness
narrative: ace-web gives the ACE team a persistent, multi-player chat interface on top of Claude with streaming responses, session library, and share links.

jj.name: Jonathan Jackson
jj.intro: Jonathan leads the ACE initiative and uses ace-web daily for Claude conversations about CRISPR-Connect opportunities.

slides.title: Library — session overview
slides.narration: Clean session management with search, filter by status, and one-click archive — not just a chat box, a real workspace.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — 9 realistic project sessions visible. B: App Page 5/5 — clean header with search/filter/upload/new chat. C: Screenshot 5/5 — full page captured. D: Slide 5/5 — clearly demonstrates the workspace. E: Demo Ready 5/5 — presentable to stakeholders.

slides.title: New chat — created via /chat
slides.narration: One-click new chat creation. The recent sessions sidebar gives instant context across all your conversations.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 4/5 (weakest: Demo Ready). A: Content 4/5 — populated sidebar adds context. B: App Page 4/5 — sidebar + chat layout clean. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 4/5 — shows the new-chat flow. E: Demo Ready 4/5 — CLI not connected banner is the only ding.

slides.title: Chat — message sent with stop button visible
slides.narration: Type and send. The user message appears immediately, and a stop button shows during streaming so any participant can cancel an in-flight model call.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 4/5 (weakest: Demo Ready). A: Content 5/5 — user message bubble visible, stop button red and enabled. B: App Page 4/5. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5 — actual chat interaction. E: Demo Ready 4/5 — CLI banner in header but the interaction is the focus.

slides.title: Share — read-only link
slides.narration: One-click share links with clipboard copy fallback. Anonymous read-only access without exposing participant identities.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 4/5 (weakest: Demo Ready). A: Content 4/5 — share link created with manual copy fallback for restricted contexts. B: App Page 4/5 — popover layout clean. C: Screenshot 4/5. D: Slide 4/5. E: Demo Ready 4/5 — fixed the contradictory feedback issue caught during this walkthrough.

slides.title: Settings — personal API tokens
slides.narration: Self-service token management for the ace-upload CLI. Create, view creation date, and revoke — no admin needed.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — demo-laptop token visible. B: App Page 5/5 — clean settings. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5 — token management clearly demonstrated. E: Demo Ready 5/5 — presentable.
